text: ok. so now same thing for props. but instead of the faces, you show the parts of the prop, so i can skin it
resolution: Brought the redesigned PAINT panel to PROPS: when the iso selection is prop pieces, the panel shows the prop's PARTS (from the SAME propParts the renderer + bake use) instead of the front/back/sides face row — each part shows its real current look, click one to target it (a texture then skins just that part), none targeted = skin every part. This is per-INSTANCE skinning, mirroring the build-piece pieceSkinSet flow. New plumbing: PlacedBuildPiece gains a partTextures field; a new piecePartTextureSet world event + stream reducer merges/clears partTextures[partId] (id stays stable so the selection survives part-by-part skinning); the event was added to the useBuildUndo + PlayRoute map-scoping switches; propFromPiece (now exported) and the compile bridge pushPlacedPieces thread partTextures into the derived WorldProp so a placed prop renders (DataProp + TexturedParts) AND bakes its part skins; WorldPartCaptures in IsoAuthor now also covers the placed prop pieces (texturedPropsFromPieces) so the iso pane bakes the part textures. In prop mode the colour swatches + brush readout hide (a prop part wears a texture, not a flat colour); the material browser + image upload + painter button drive it. This commit also folds in the held req_0757 foundation it builds on. Verified by a clean full-graph esbuild pass (exit 0). WHERE TO TEST: select a placed prop in the iso /route, the PAINT panel shows its parts; pick a texture to skin one or all. Still open (next): the graffiti painter to the right of the skin list, for props AND faces.
